## 6. Findings / defects (derived, not asserted)

- SI: episodes of 21+ members are 13.5% of episodes but hold 69.1% of candidates — the chain-link clause welds busy same-side sessions into one giant episode; the gap sweep {600, 900, 1800}s is the sensitivity receipt.
- HG: episodes of 21+ members are 12.2% of episodes but hold 62.2% of candidates — the chain-link clause welds busy same-side sessions into one giant episode; the gap sweep {600, 900, 1800}s is the sensitivity receipt.
